scope: UK supply chain; GB electricity system and market

title.en: The complete chain: four maps, not one hierarchy
title.zh: 完整产业链：四种关系分开看

en.text:
INDUSTRIAL DELIVERY
Materials → Components → Subsystems → Engineered/manufactured packages
          → Installation and integration → Operating wind farm

PROJECT DEVELOPMENT
Rights + surveys + consent + design + grid + revenue + finance
          → Investment decision → Construction → Operation → Decommissioning

PERMISSIONS AND COORDINATION — alongside the delivery chain
Seabed manager · consenting authorities · environmental advisers
Government · Ofgem · NESO · industry codes

ELECTRICITY AND ITS MARKET — two separate flows
Physical: Wind farm → Network → Consumers
Money:    Buyers → Generator; LCCC ↔ Generator; Network users → Network revenue

**Typical practice / interpretation.** The table below describes normal customers and risks, not a universal contract structure. A developer can buy directly or through package contractors. EPCI means *engineer, procure, construct and install*; using it transfers some delivery risk for a price, rather than eliminating risk. [Procurement structures — BVG/ORE guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/procurement-structures/).

rows: Materials
Steel products, copper/aluminium, concrete inputs, composite fibres/resins
Component maker pays materials processor; processor buys feedstock
Commodity price, energy cost, provenance, grade/quality

Tata Steel UK participates in a floating-platform steel R&D collaboration; that is not a commercial farm supply award. [Tata Steel](https://www.tatasteeluk.com/corporate/news/industrial-collaboration-to-develop-strip-steel-floating-offshore-wind-platforms)
Components
Fabricated plates, chain, rope, cable cores, connectors, blades, bearings
Subsystem supplier pays specialist manufacturer
Fatigue quality, defects, qualification, delivery slots

Bridon-Bekaert and Lankhorst supply mooring-line products; the line designer specifies the system. [Mooring lines guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-3-mooring-system/b-3-2-mooring-lines/)
Subsystems
Turbine electrical equipment, station keeping, dynamic cable assemblies
OEM or package lead pays subsystem suppliers
Compatibility, loads, thermal performance, certification evidence
Electrical component firms supply into turbine packages; OEM integration matters. [Turbine electrical guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/t-wind-turbine/t-4-electrical-system/)
Packages
Designed turbine, floater, mooring spread, electrical network
Project company pays OEM/fabricator/package contractor
Design changes, warranties, fabrication rate, cost escalation

Principle Power supplies floating technology; fabricators and contractors build/deliver structures under the chosen scope. [Floater guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-2-floating-substructure/)
Integration / marine delivery
An installed, connected and tested system
Project company or package lead pays ports, installers and vessel contractors
Weather, vessel availability, damage, schedule interfaces
Boskalis documents transport/installation work at Kincardine. [Contractor case study](https://boskalis.com/media/jgldcrcn/kincardine.pdf)
Developer / project company
A permitted, financed generation business and coordinated contracts
Sponsors fund development/equity; lenders may fund construction; project company pays suppliers
Unbuilt-project losses, interface gaps, revenue and completion

A special-purpose vehicle (SPV) holds the project and contracts specialist work. [Development services guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/p-development-and-project-management/p-1-development-and-consenting-services/)
Transmission infrastructure
Available connection capacity between offshore generation and the wider grid
Under traditional generator-build OFTO arrangements, OFTO buys assessed assets; licensed revenue supports ownership/O&M
Cable failure, availability, asset transfer, repair

OFTO is a licensed asset owner, not the purchaser of generated electricity. [DESNZ OFTO explanation](https://www.gov.uk/government/calls-for-evidence/offshore-transmission-owner-ofto-regime/offshore-transmission-owner-regime-ofto-call-for-evidence-accessible-webpage)
Electricity system / market
Real-time balancing, network access and commercial settlement
Buyers pay generators; network charges and balancing/settlement cashflows follow separate rules
Forecast error, constraints, outages, price exposure

NESO balances; Elexon administers BSC settlement. [NESO BM](https://www.neso.energy/what-we-do/systems-operations/what-balancing-mechanism), [Elexon trading](https://www.elexon.co.uk/bsc/about/trading-electricty-market/)
Public coordination / regulation
Rights, permissions, licences, policy and consumer protection
Applicants may pay fees/rent; this is not an equipment-purchase tier
Environmental acceptability, statutory compliance, policy change
Seabed manager, consenting authority, Ofgem and DESNZ have different jobs. See jurisdiction and market sections below.

title.en: The developer is the project integrator
title.zh: 开发商是项目集成方

en.text: **Terms.** An OEM is an original equipment manufacturer. PMO means project management office; HSE means health, safety and environment. These functions may be internal or contracted.

**Typical practice.** The developer does not manufacture every item. It makes separately designed packages deliver one buildable, operable business. Functions may be internal, seconded, shared across a joint venture or outsourced; these are responsibilities, not a mandatory organisation chart.

en.text: The grouping above is our explanatory model. FEED is *front-end engineering and design*: it develops the integrated design and procurement basis. Project management links technical packages to budgets, construction and power-sales arrangements. [Engineering/FEED guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/p-development-and-project-management/p-5-engineering-and-consultancy/), [Project management guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/p-development-and-project-management/p-6-project-management/).

**Interpretation example.** A larger turbine can change floater loads, mooring tension, cable excursions, crane requirements, consent dimensions and financing costs. The technical team cannot approve it independently of the commercial, consenting, port and operations teams. The developer needs one controlled interface register and a way to assess changes across packages.

**通常做法。** 开发商不制造全部设备，而是使独立设备包构成一个能够建设、运行并获得收入的项目。以下是职责分组，不要求每个开发商有同样的部门；工作可以自有、借调、合资共享或外包。

title.en: The lifecycle: chronological decisions, parallel work
title.zh: 项目生命周期：决策有先后，工作常并行

en.text: **Terms.** FID means final investment decision. FEED means front-end engineering and design. A PPA is a power purchase agreement; CfD means Contract for Difference. TO means transmission owner; DNO means distribution network operator.

en.text: Evidence for development workstreams: [environmental surveys](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/p-development-and-project-management/p-2-environmental-surveys/), [resource/metocean](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/p-development-and-project-management/p-3-resource-and-metocean-assessment/), [geological/hydrographical surveys](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/p-development-and-project-management/p-4-geological-and-hydrographical-surveys/). Permission, connection, revenue, installation and end-of-life evidence is detailed in the corresponding permissions, grid, CfD, ports, installation and O&M topics. The exit gates are our engineering/commercial interpretation, not claims that a regulator signs off every stage.

title.en: Who controls seabed rights and permissions?
title.zh: 海床权利与建设许可由谁管理？

en.text: **Terms.** MD-LOT is the Marine Directorate Licensing Operations Team. MMO is the Marine Management Organisation; NRW is Natural Resources Wales. DCO means Development Consent Order; NSIP means Nationally Significant Infrastructure Project; PEDW is Planning and Environment Decisions Wales.

**Confirmed distinction:** an option, agreement for lease or lease is a property/ development-rights agreement. Consent authorises specified activities under law. Neither automatically supplies grid access, a CfD or financing. [Crown Estate Scotland's explanation](https://www.crownestatescotland.com/news/foi-382scotwind-revenue).

rows: Scotland
Crown Estate Scotland manages relevant Scottish seabed rights
Scottish Ministers; MD-LOT processes relevant marine licences and section 36 consents
Onshore planning is a separate workstream through the relevant route/local authority; NatureScot/JNCC provide nature-conservation advice within their remits
England
The Crown Estate
For NSIPs, Planning Inspectorate examination and Secretary of State decision through a DCO; MMO determines relevant marine licences or administers deemed-licence functions
Onshore works may be within a DCO or need separate planning permission; Natural England and other bodies advise
Wales
The Crown Estate
NRW is the marine licensing authority on behalf of Welsh Ministers; generation consent may use devolved infrastructure consent or the reserved NSIP route, with transitional/project-specific treatment
PEDW/Welsh Ministers and local planning authorities have roles under the applicable route; NRW and JNCC provide environmental advice within their remits

en.text: Scottish requirements are explained in [MD-LOT guidance, updated 29 September 2026](https://www.gov.scot/publications/marine-licensing-and-consenting-offshore-renewable-energy-projects/pages/licensing-and-consenting-requirements/). Environmental advisers inform the decision; they are not interchangeable with the seabed landlord or the consenting authority. [JNCC responsibilities](https://jncc.defra.gov.uk/our-work/ornithology-renewables/).

**Changing arrangements.** England's [MMO guidance, updated 3 August 2026](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/offshore-energy-generation-consents) explicitly warns against choosing the consent route from capacity alone. Wales' Significant Infrastructure Projects (SIP) regime commenced in December 2025; current [SIP guidance](https://www.gov.wales/significant-infrastructure-projects-sip-what-submit-your-application) includes provisions for deemed marine licences. The [UK NSIP guidance](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/nationally-significant-infrastructure-projects-development-consent-legislation) explains reserved/devolved boundaries, including the 350 MW offshore-generation boundary for Wales. Site location, cross-border infrastructure, directions and transitional rules still matter. Do not reuse the 2023 Welsh flowchart as a complete current decision tree.

title.en: From rotor to seabed
title.zh: 从转子到海床

en.text:
Wind → blades + hub (rotor) → drivetrain / generator inside the nacelle
                            → power converter → transformer → cable
                    │
                  tower
                    │
                 floater
             ┌──────┴────────┐
        mooring lines    dynamic power cable
             │               │
           anchors        seabed cable/network
             │
        seabed / soil

**Typical physical functions.** Blades extract aerodynamic energy; the rotor turns the drivetrain. The generator converts mechanical power into electrical power. Designs may be geared or direct drive. The nacelle encloses major machinery; the tower carries rotor/nacelle loads to the floater. [US Department of Energy — first-principles explanation](https://www.energy.gov/cmei/systems/how-do-wind-turbines-work).

The floater supplies buoyancy/stability; moorings limit movement; anchors transmit mooring loads into the soil. The seabed is a design input, not another manufactured component. Cable and mooring geometry must leave room for motion and installation. [Floating substructure guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-2-floating-substructure/), [anchor guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-3-mooring-system/b-3-1-anchors/).

headers: Consequences to examine, not universal rankings
rows: Semi-submersible
Buoyancy distributed across separated columns/pontoons
Often compatible with quayside turbine integration; wide footprint, structural fabrication and port space matter; compliant moorings allow motion that cables must accommodate
Spar
A deep, slender, ballasted body lowers the centre of gravity
Large draft can constrain assembly/towing ports and require deep sheltered integration water; motions and station keeping still need site-specific analysis
TLP: tension-leg platform
Excess buoyancy is restrained by tensioned tendons
Can reduce some motions but introduces tendon/anchor uplift demands; stability during transport/installation may need temporary support; cable design still depends on actual response

en.text: These are mechanism-based tradeoffs. Steel/concrete, fabrication method, water depth, turbine size, port access and installation strategy can outweigh the headline concept. There is no universally cheapest or most scalable winner. [Floating technology guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/floating-technology/).

zh.text:
风 → 叶片＋轮毂（转子） → 机舱内传动链／发电机 → 变流器 → 变压器 → 海缆
                          │
                         塔架
                          │
                         浮体
                    ┌─────┴─────┐
                  系泊线      动态海缆
                    │            │
                    锚         海床电缆／网络
                    │
                 海床／土体
**通常原理。** 叶片捕获空气动力能，转子带动传动链，发电机把机械能转为电能。机型可有齿轮箱，也可直驱。机舱容纳主要机械，塔架把上部载荷传到浮体。
浮体提供浮力和稳定性，系泊限制位移，锚把载荷传入土体。海床是设计条件，不是制造部件；海缆和系泊必须留出运动及安装空间。

通常适合码头集成；占地、结构制造与港口空间重要；柔顺系泊允许的运动需由海缆承受

过剩浮力由预张紧筋腱约束

title.en: Why dynamic cables are a system problem
title.zh: 动态海缆为何必须从系统角度分析？

en.text:
Floater cable hang-off + bend control
      ↓ suspended/free-hanging length
      ↑ buoyancy-supported arch (lazy wave example)
      ↓ lower suspended section
Touchdown zone ↔ changing contact with seabed
      → static cable section / joint, where used → array network

**Typical practice.** The hang-off carries the cable into the floater; bend control limits local curvature. Buoyancy modules shape the suspended cable so motion is absorbed across a compliant configuration. Lazy wave is one solution, not the only geometry. The touchdown zone is where contact with the seabed changes as the system moves. A dynamic-to-static transition may be included; some designs use longer dynamic lengths instead. [Cable connection study — ORE Catapult](https://ore.catapult.org.uk/resource-hub/analysis-reports/cornwall-flow-accelerator-optimised-cable-connection-options-for-floating-offshore-wind), [dynamic cable qualification report](https://ore.catapult.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Dynamic-Cable-Technology-Qualification-Oct-2022.pdf).

**Engineering interpretation:** floater motion changes the cable-end position; mooring stiffness and pretension change the floater's excursion; cable geometry then changes curvature, tension and seabed interaction. Design checks therefore need compatible coupled response and load cases, including extreme conditions, fatigue and relevant faults. Moorings are station-keeping equipment; the power cable is not a substitute mooring line. [Mooring-system response and cable excursion](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-3-mooring-system/).

zh.text:
浮体挂点＋弯曲控制
    ↓ 自由悬垂段
    ↑ 浮力模块托起的拱段（懒波形示例）
    ↓ 下部悬垂段
触地点区域 ↔ 随运动改变的海床接触
    → 静态海缆段／接头（如采用） → 阵列网络
**通常做法。** 挂点承接海缆，弯曲控制装置限制局部曲率；浮力模块塑造柔顺外形以吸收运动。懒波形只是方案之一。触地区域的接触位置随运动变化；动态到静态的过渡并非每个方案都有。
**工程解读。** 浮体改变海缆端部位置；系泊刚度、预张力影响偏移；海缆形状再影响曲率、张力和海床作用。因此必须使用相容的耦合响应、极端载荷、疲劳和适用故障工况。系泊负责定位，电缆不能当系泊线。

title.en: Array and export architecture
title.zh: 阵列与送出网络

en.text: **Typical practice.** Several turbines connect along a string; multiple strings feed collection points. Network topology, protection and switching decide which output is lost when a cable section fails. A dynamic section accommodates the floater; static seabed sections carry power where motion requirements permit. 66 kV is a common array design point, not a law or a statement about every installed project. [Array cable guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-1-cables/b-1-1-array-cable/).

HVAC means high-voltage alternating current. Longer AC cables introduce reactive power/charging constraints. HVDC means high-voltage direct current: converters add cost and complexity, but DC can suit long/high-capacity export. The choice depends on capacity, distance, losses, network design and available equipment; there is no single universal distance where DC becomes compulsory. [HVAC system](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-4-offshore-substation/b-4-1-hvac-electrical-system/), [HVDC system](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-4-offshore-substation/b-4-2-hvdc-electrical-system/).

Burial/protection needs route surveys and ground assessment. Crossings can need agreements and engineered separation/protection. Installation includes laying, pull-in, termination and testing; a laid cable is not yet a commissioned circuit. [Offshore cable installation guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/i-installation-and-commissioning/i-2-offshore-cable-installation/).

zh.text: **通常做法。** 多台风机组成回路，多个回路接入汇集点。拓扑、开关和保护决定故障会切掉多少发电量。运动端需要动态段，允许静态敷设的位置可使用海床静态段。66 kV 是常见设计点，不是法规，也不代表全部已建项目。
HVAC 为高压交流，较长电缆会带来无功和充电效应；HVDC 为高压直流，需要较昂贵复杂的换流设备，但可能适合长距离或大容量送出。选择取决于容量、距离、损耗、网络设计和设备，没有统一的距离分界线。
埋设与防护需调查地层和路由；交叉段可能需要协议、间距和专项防护。敷缆、牵入、终端连接和测试都是工作范围，敷完不等于已调试可用。

title.en: What substations actually do
title.zh: 变电站实际做什么？

en.text: **Typical practice.** An offshore substation joins array circuits to export circuits. Transformers change AC voltage; switchgear isolates equipment; protection detects faults and trips the right equipment. Reactive-power equipment helps manage AC network conditions. Control, communications, auxiliary power and metering support operation. An HVDC design adds conversion equipment. [Offshore substation guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-4-offshore-substation/).

The onshore substation conditions power for the connection point, with equipment depending on AC/DC choice. It is distinct from the adjacent TO network plant, even when physically close. [Onshore electrical system](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/b-balance-of-plant/b-5-onshore-substation/b-5-1-electrical-system/).

**Do not infer a floating substation from floating turbines.** Alternatives include a fixed substation at a suitable location, direct export for a suitable smaller scheme, or a project-specific connection to other offshore infrastructure. The BVG/ORE reference case itself assumes a fixed substation. [Reference-design assumptions](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/1-2-assumptions-used-in-this-guide/).

zh.text: **通常做法。** 海上站连接阵列与送出回路。变压器改变交流电压；开关设备隔离电路；保护识别故障并切除适当设备；无功设备管理交流网络状态；控制、通信、辅助电源和计量支持运行。直流方案还需要换流。
陆上站把电力调节到并网所需状态；它与相邻 TO 设施即使在同一地区，也可能有不同产权和责任。
**不能从“风机是浮式”推导“海上站必须浮式”。** 可以采用适当位置的固定站、适合小型项目的直接送出，或连接其他海上设施。BVG／ORE 参考方案本身采用固定海上站。

title.en: OFTO: owning the offshore transmission connection
title.zh: OFTO：拥有海上输电连接

en.text: **Terms.** OFTO means Offshore Transmission Owner: a licensed owner of specified offshore transmission assets.
**Traditional generator-build model:**

Developer builds generation + relevant transmission assets
              ↓
Ofgem assesses transfer value and runs competitive OFTO tender
              ↓
Selected licensed OFTO purchases relevant transmission assets
              ↓
OFTO owns/manages those assets under licence and revenue arrangements

Generation normally includes turbines and their collection system. The offshore transmission scope commonly includes export connection infrastructure, relevant substation equipment and onshore connection assets up to the agreed boundary. The exact boundary follows licences, technical classification and asset-transfer documents—not a universal line at the shoreline. [DESNZ generator-build explanation](https://www.gov.uk/government/calls-for-evidence/offshore-transmission-owner-ofto-regime/offshore-transmission-owner-regime-ofto-call-for-evidence-accessible-webpage).

**Project example:** Greater Gabbard OFTO connects a fixed-bottom wind farm; its published portfolio description identifies availability-based revenue and a separate O&M operator. It illustrates the ownership business model, not a floating wind award. [Equitix portfolio](https://equitix.com/portfolio/greater-gabbard-ofto/).

**Changing arrangements:** Ofgem's May 2026 early/late competition OFTO-build consultation is listed as closed awaiting decision at this review. Coordinated offshore networks may be procured and delivered differently from a single developer-built radial cable. Do not present consultation proposals as final rules or assume every future offshore asset is transferred the same way. [Ofgem consultation and status](https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/consultation/ofto-build-early-and-late-competition-models).

zh.text: **术语。** OFTO 是 Offshore Transmission Owner，即持有许可指定海上输电资产的业主。

开发商建设发电设施及相关输电设施
       ↓
Ofgem 评估移交价值并组织 OFTO 竞争招标
       ↓
获许可 OFTO 收购指定输电资产
       ↓
依许可和收入安排持有、管理这些资产
**传统开发商建设模式。** 发电范围通常包括风机与汇集系统；输电范围常包括送出连接、相关变电设备和至约定边界的陆上资产。边界依许可、技术分类和移交文件，不是固定在海岸线。
**项目示例。** Greater Gabbard OFTO 服务的是固定式风场。Equitix 说明其收入与资产可用性相关，并列出独立运维方；这是产权商业模式示例，不是浮式项目订单。
**制度变化。** Ofgem 2026 年 5 月早期／后期竞争 OFTO-build 咨询在本次复核时仍标为关闭、待决定。协调海上网络可能采用不同采购和交付方式；咨询方案不是已生效统一规则，也不能假设未来资产全走同样移交路径。

title.en: Developer, OFTO, TO and NESO are different jobs
title.zh: 开发商、OFTO、TO 与 NESO 各做什么？

en.text: **Terms.** NESO is the National Energy System Operator. NGET is National Grid Electricity Transmission. TO means transmission owner. Ofgem is the energy regulator; NESO is the system operator, not the regulator or network owner.

rows: Developer / generation project company
Develops and owns/contracts the wind-farm business
Ownership of the whole GB grid
OFTO
Licensed owner of specified offshore transmission assets
Wind-farm ownership or a power-purchase contract

Builds, maintains and owns its physical transmission network
Dispatch/balancing of the whole GB system
NESO
Operates the GB electricity system, coordinates connections and plans system needs
Ownership of the transmission network or purchase of all electricity

en.text: NGET covers England/Wales; SSEN Transmission covers northern Scotland; SP Transmission covers central/southern Scotland. NESO works with these owners. [National Grid connection roles](https://www.nationalgrid.com/electricity-transmission/connections/article/distribution-and-transmission-connections), [NESO Scottish network boundaries](https://www.neso.energy/publications/electricity-ten-year-statement-etys/electricity-transmission-network-requirements/scottish-boundaries).

NESO balances supply/demand and uses response, reserve and the Balancing Mechanism to maintain secure operation and frequency around 50 Hz. Constraints mean power cannot always be moved from the available generator to demand. [NESO control-centre explanation](https://www.neso.energy/what-we-do/systems-operations/what-does-electricity-national-control-centre-do).

**Changing arrangements:** connections reform assesses readiness and strategic alignment. Gate 1 does not supply a confirmed connection date; eligible Gate 2 projects can secure dates/points/queue positions through the relevant process. Even then, inspect the actual offer and reinforcement obligations. [NESO evidence handbook](https://www.neso.energy/industry-information/connections-reform/evidence-handbook-and-other-g2wq-submission-resources).

title.en: Physical flow and financial flow
title.zh: 电力实物流与资金流

en.text:
PHYSICAL: Generator → interconnected network → demand

COMMERCIAL:
Power buyer / trader / supplier → Generator (market sale or PPA)
Generator ↔ LCCC (eligible CfD difference payment)
Market participants ↔ BSC settlement (contracted versus metered positions)
Network charging / regulated revenue (separate from buying the energy)

**Typical retail route.** Consumers pay their electricity supplier. The supplier buys energy directly or through trading arrangements and faces network and scheme costs as well as its own operating costs. Corporate PPAs and trading intermediaries can change the commercial route; they do not create a dedicated physical cable to that customer.

A PPA is a power purchase agreement. Generators sell power through market/ contract arrangements; a commercial buyer is not a dedicated physical route for individual electrons. Forecasts inform sold volumes. Actual output may differ; imbalance settlement accounts for the discrepancy under the Balancing and Settlement Code (BSC), administered by Elexon. Settlement periods are half-hourly; this does not mean the physical system balances only every half hour. [Elexon trading/settlement explanation](https://www.elexon.co.uk/bsc/about/trading-electricty-market/).

NESO's Balancing Mechanism accepts changes in generation or demand to operate the system in real time. Congestion may require output to be reduced in one area and replaced elsewhere; curtailment payments depend on the applicable action and arrangements. [NESO BM explanation](https://www.neso.energy/what-we-do/systems-operations/what-balancing-mechanism).

Negative wholesale prices can occur; they do not guarantee that every generator continues to receive its CfD strike price. Current government guidance explains negative day-ahead price restrictions on difference payments for contracts from AR4 onward. Contract version and settlement rules matter. [DESNZ market-design update](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/reformed-national-pricing-rnp-delivery-plan/reformed-national-pricing-rnp-delivery-plan-accessible-webpage).

zh.text:
实物：发电 → 互联网络 → 用电需求
商业：购电方／交易商／售电商 → 发电商（售电或 PPA）
      发电商 ↔ LCCC（符合条件的 CfD 差额）
      市场参与方 ↔ BSC 偏差结算
      网络收费与监管收入另行安排
**典型零售路径。** 用户向售电商付电费；售电商直接或通过交易安排购电，并承担网络、有关机制及自身运营成本。企业 PPA 与交易中间方会改变商业路径，但不会为该客户形成一条专用物理电缆。
PPA 是购电协议。商业买家并不拥有一条供特定电子专用的物理路径。预测用于安排售电，实发与合同头寸可能不同；Elexon 管理的 BSC（平衡与结算规则）用于核算偏差。结算以半小时为周期，不表示物理平衡每半小时才做一次。
NESO 的 Balancing Mechanism 接受发电／用电变化以实时运行系统。阻塞可能要求某地减发、另一地补发；限制发电的付款取决于具体行动与规则。
批发电价可以为负，但不保证所有发电商仍收到执行价。政府指导说明 AR4 起合同对负日前价格时段的差额支付有限制；具体合同版本与结算规则必须核对。

title.en: CfD: revenue stabilisation, not government power purchase
title.zh: CfD：稳定收入，不是政府包购电力

en.text: **Terms.** CfD means Contract for Difference. DESNZ is the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero; LCCC is the Low Carbon Contracts Company. AR means allocation round; CPI is the consumer prices index.

**Confirmed structure.** DESNZ sets scheme policy; NESO is the auction Delivery Body; LCCC is the government-owned contract counterparty. The generator still arranges physical power sales. CfD payments settle the eligible difference between a strike price and a specified market reference price. [DESNZ scheme](https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/contracts-for-difference), [LCCC clarification on power sales](https://www.lowcarboncontracts.uk/documents/243/Introduction_to_the_Contracts_for_Difference_Scheme_QA_.pdf).

**Funding the CfD.** Electricity suppliers fund the scheme through a statutory supplier obligation. LCCC makes or receives the contractual difference payments; this is separate from the generator selling electricity. [LCCC funding and settlement explanation](https://www.lowcarboncontracts.uk/documents/203/Binary_Carbon_Webinar_-_9.7.2024.pdf).

**Illustrative arithmetic only:** assume 1 eligible MWh, strike £100/MWh and a realised sale price equal to the reference price. Ignore losses, fees, indexation and payment exclusions solely for this example.

rows: £60/MWh
LCCC pays generator £40
Generator pays LCCC £40

en.text: If realised sales differ from the reference price, combined revenue differs too. CfD reduces one revenue risk; wind resource, outages, negative-price exclusions, imbalance costs and delivery obligations remain. Lower revenue uncertainty can support investment, but a CfD is not a financing decision. [LCCC mechanism presentation](https://www.lowcarboncontracts.uk/documents/203/Binary_Carbon_Webinar_-_9.7.2024.pdf).

**Changing contract terms:** DESNZ confirms 20-year CPI-indexed contracts from AR7 for relevant wind/solar technologies, including floating offshore wind. Do not describe all CfDs as 15-year contracts. [DESNZ 2025 scheme update](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/contracts-for-difference-and-capacity-market-scheme-update-2025/contracts-for-difference-and-capacity-market-scheme-update-2025-accessible-webpage).

**Dated award example:** DESNZ's 14 January 2026 AR7 results list Pentland 92.5 MW and Erebus 100 MW in the floating category. These are awarded capacities, not proof of FID or operational generation, and not necessarily the whole project's consent envelope. [Official AR7 results](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6966861de8c04eb2919f773a/contracts-for-difference-allocation-round-7-results-.pdf).

zh.text: **术语。** CfD 为差价合约；DESNZ 为英国能源安全与净零部；LCCC 为低碳合同公司；AR 指分配轮次；CPI 指消费者价格指数。
**已确认结构。** DESNZ 制定政策，NESO 执行分配竞拍，LCCC 是政府持有的合同对手方。发电商仍需安排实物售电；CfD 按执行价与指定市场参考价的差额结算。
**CfD 资金来源。** 售电商通过法定供应商缴费义务为机制提供资金；LCCC 支付或收取合同差额。这与发电商另行出售电力分开。
**仅作算术示例。** 假设 1 MWh 符合支付条件，执行价 £100/MWh，实际售电价恰好等于参考价。为说明原理暂不计损耗、费用、指数调整及支付排除规则。

rows: £60/MWh
LCCC 向发电商支付 £40
发电商向 LCCC 支付 £40

zh.text: 实际售电价不等于参考价时，合计收入也会不同。CfD 减少一种价格风险，但风资源、停机、负价排除、偏差成本和交付义务仍在；CfD 本身不是融资决定。
**合同变化。** DESNZ 确认 AR7 起包括浮式风电在内的有关风能／太阳能采用 20 年 CPI（消费者价格指数）调整合同；不能把所有 CfD 都称为 15 年合同。
**有日期的结果。** 2026-01-14 AR7 官方结果列出 Pentland 92.5 MW、Erebus 100 MW 浮式获配容量；这不是已 FID 或已发电的证据，也不一定等于项目全部许可容量。

title.en: Financing and FID: can this technical design be funded?
title.zh: 融资与 FID：技术方案能否获得资金？

en.text: **Typical practice / commercial interpretation.** Sponsors fund at-risk development. Equity bears ownership risk; debt providers expect repayment and test downside cashflows. Project finance relies substantially on the project and its contracts/cashflows; balance-sheet funding uses the sponsor's wider capacity. Not every project must use the same financing structure.

Before a major investment commitment, decision-makers normally seek sufficiently mature consent/land rights, credible grid timing, deliverable technology, contracted or understood CAPEX (capital expenditure), viable revenue/offtake, construction and O&M plans, allocated interfaces, insurance and contingency. Some conditions remain to be discharged after FID; maturity does not mean every risk is gone. Contract packaging affects the risk retained by the developer. [Procurement and financing tradeoffs](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/procurement-structures/).

**Project example:** Great British Energy describes early investment alongside the National Wealth Fund and Scottish National Investment Bank in Pentland in November 2025. Such investment supports development; it should not be relabelled as completed construction finance or FID without further evidence. [GBE investment announcement](https://www.gbe.gov.uk/blog/major-floating-offshore-wind-project-secures-backing-great-british-energy-national-wealth-fund).

zh.text: **通常做法／商业解读。** 股东承担有风险的前期开发支出；股权承担所有者风险，贷款方关注还款和不利现金流情景。项目融资主要依赖项目合同与现金流，资产负债表融资则依靠股东更广泛的财力，并非所有项目采用同一种结构。
重大投资前通常需使许可和土地权利、并网时序、技术、CAPEX（资本支出）、收入／购电、建造、运维、接口分工、保险和预备金足够成熟。FID 后仍可能有待落实条件；“成熟”不等于“没有风险”。合同打包方式改变开发商承担的风险。
**项目示例。** GBE 说明其于 2025 年 11 月与 National Wealth Fund、Scottish National Investment Bank 等共同投资 Pentland。早期资金支持开发，不能在无更多证据时称为已完成建设融资或 FID。

title.en: Ports and manufacturing: the production line meets the sea
title.zh: 港口与制造：生产线连接海洋

en.text:
Floater manufacture / assembly → quayside or wet storage
→ tower → nacelle → blades → pre-commissioning
→ wet storage as needed → tow-out

**Typical sequence for a suitable integrated-tow design.** Assembly can use landside heavy cranes or other engineered lifting arrangements. Component delivery, structural completion, lifting, ballast control and tests must be coordinated. Spars and TLPs can require different integration/transport solutions. [Floating turbine assembly guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/i-installation-and-commissioning/i-5-floating-offshore-wind-turbine-assembly/).

Port suitability is a bundle: crane capacity/reach, quay bearing pressure, water depth and tides, unobstructed tow route, laydown area, wet storage/moorings, workforce and repeatable throughput. A large quay alone is insufficient. A manufacturing port, integration port, marshalling port and O&M base need not be the same place. [Construction-port guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/i-installation-and-commissioning/i-8-construction-port/).

**UK examples, not reserved project ports:** DESNZ announced support for Cromarty Firth port expansion in March 2025. In March 2026, government announced up to £64 million for Port Talbot design/engineering work. Neither announcement alone proves all future capacity is built or allocated. [Cromarty Firth](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/government-unlocks-floating-offshore-wind-with-major-investment-for-scottish-port), [Port Talbot](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/64-million-for-port-talbot-offshore-wind-hub-in-the-celtic-sea). Haventus describes Ardersier's energy-transition facility and phased development. Use phase-specific evidence when discussing available facilities. [Ardersier developer](https://www.haventus.com/port-page/ardersier-energy-transition-facility/).

zh.text:
浮体制造／组装 → 码头或湿储
→ 塔架 → 机舱 → 叶片 → 预调试
→ 必要的湿储 → 拖出
**适用于可整体拖航方案的典型流程。** 可使用岸上重吊等经设计的吊装方案；部件到港、结构完工、吊装、压载与测试需要协调。Spar 和 TLP 可能需要不同运输和集成方法。
港口适配是多项条件同时满足：吊重和幅度、码头承载、水深潮位、无障碍拖航通道、堆场、湿储及系泊、人员和重复生产节拍。制造港、集成港、中转港和运维基地不必是同一处。
**英国例子，不代表已预订。** DESNZ 于 2025 年 3 月宣布支持 Cromarty Firth 扩建；2026 年 3 月宣布对 Port Talbot 设计工程支持最高 £64 million。公告本身不证明全部未来产能已建成或分配。Haventus 对 Ardersier 的设施描述也应区分开发阶段。

title.en: Offshore installation: two work fronts converge
title.zh: 海上安装：两条工作面汇合

en.text:
OFFSHORE: survey / route clearance
            ├→ anchors → mooring pre-installation / tests ───┐
            └→ cable / substation works as designed ────────┤
PORT:     assembly → tests → tow-out ────────────────────────┤
                                                           ↓
        mooring hook-up → dynamic cable hook-up
        → electrical commissioning → authorised energisation

This is typical logic, not a fixed vessel schedule. Anchor-handling vessels, tugs, cable-lay vessels, ROVs (remotely operated underwater vehicles), survey vessels and specialist technicians serve different tasks. The chosen anchors, cables and platform determine installation equipment and sequence. [Mooring pre-installation](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/i-installation-and-commissioning/i-4-anchor-and-mooring-pre-installation/), [turbine installation](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/i-installation-and-commissioning/i-6-floating-offshore-wind-turbine-installation/).

**Interpretation:** tow-out is only ready when site readiness, port release, weather windows, safe tow route, mooring/cable connection and contingency plans align. Installing the turbine before a usable export system risks stranded generation. Weather windows need duration and sea-state suitability, not just a single wind-speed limit. [Installation overview](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/i-installation-and-commissioning/).

zh.text:
海上调查／清理 ─┬→ 锚 → 预装系泊／测试 ─┐
               └→ 海缆／变电站工程 ─────┤
港口：组装 → 测试 → 拖出 ───────────────┤
                                      ↓
系泊连接 → 动态海缆连接 → 电气调试 → 获授权送电
这是典型逻辑，不是固定船期。拖轮、起锚／锚处理船、敷缆船、调查船、ROV（水下遥控机器人）及专业技术人员承担不同任务；锚、海缆和浮体设计决定具体设备与顺序。
**工程解读。** 拖航前应使海上准备、港口放行、天气窗口、拖航路线、系泊／海缆连接和应急方案一致。若送出系统未就绪，已安装风机也可能无法交付电力；作业窗口取决于持续时间及海况，而不只一个风速限值。

title.en: O&M and end of life
title.zh: 运维与寿命末责任

en.text: **Typical operating chain.** SCADA (*supervisory control and data acquisition*) and condition monitoring identify performance changes and faults. Turbine service is only one workstream: inspect floater structure, corrosion protection, marine growth, moorings, anchors and dynamic cables; use subsea inspection/ROVs and plan repair vessels, spares and access. Different asset owners can have separate responsibilities and service contracts. [O&M overview](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/o-operations-and-maintenance/), [maintenance guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/o-operations-and-maintenance/o-2-maintenance/).

**Floating-specific issue:** a major component replacement may be done offshore or by disconnecting and towing to port. Neither strategy is automatic: safe disconnection/reconnection, standby mooring/cable arrangements, suitable draft, port/crane slots and downtime must be considered. Principle Power reports both in-situ and tow-to-port major exchanges at Kincardine. [Kincardine operator/technology account](https://www.principlepower.com/projects/kincardine-offshore-wind-farm), [major repair guide](https://guidetofloatingoffshorewind.com/guide/o-operations-and-maintenance/o-3-major-repair/).

Decommissioning is a funded lifecycle obligation, not a surprise at the end. England/Wales and Scotland have separate guidance. Removal, any justified retention, monitoring and financial security follow the approved programme and applicable requirements. Do not promise that every anchor/cable is always removed. [DESNZ England/Wales guidance](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/decommissioning-offshore-renewable-energy-installations), [Scottish guidance](https://www.gov.scot/publications/offshore-renewable-energy-decommissioning-guidance-scottish-waters/documents/).

zh.text: **通常做法。** SCADA（监控与数据采集）和状态监测识别性能变化及故障。还需检查浮体、腐蚀保护、海生物、系泊、锚和动态海缆；利用 ROV、水下检查、维修船、备件和通道维持完整性。不同资产方可能各有服务合同。
**浮式特点。** 大部件更换可在海上进行，也可断开后拖回港口；两者都需检查断接和重连、临时系泊／海缆安排、吃水、港口吊机档期与停机损失。Principle Power 报告 Kincardine 有原位及拖回港口的大部件更换经验。
退役从开发期即应规划费用和责任。英格兰／威尔士与苏格兰指导不同；拆除、合理保留、监测和资金担保依获批方案和适用规则，不能保证每根锚和海缆都必然拆除。

title.en: A mental model and fifteen useful questions
title.zh: 记忆框架与十五个问题

en.text:
SEABED RIGHTS + CONSENT + GRID + REVENUE + FINANCE
       + DELIVERABLE TECHNOLOGY + SUPPLY CHAIN + PORT / MARINE PLAN
                                  ↓
                    FINAL INVESTMENT DECISION
                                  ↓
                 MANUFACTURE → INTEGRATE → INSTALL
                                  ↓
                     COMMISSION → GENERATE
                                  ↓
                TRANSMIT / DISTRIBUTE → CUSTOMERS

Alongside: separate electricity sales, network charges, CfD and settlement
Throughout: safety, stakeholders, asset integrity, O&M and end-of-life funding

This is an explanatory framework, not a universal legal sequence. Operation is a multi-decade responsibility; design life, lease duration and support-contract duration are different quantities and must be checked for the particular asset.

items: Who holds the seabed rights, and what conditions attach to them?
Who owns the project company and who manages development?
Which offshore and onshore permissions exist, and what remains conditional?
What connection point, capacity and date does the current grid offer provide?
Where will the electricity physically go, and who buys it commercially?
Is there a CfD, for which capacity/round/terms, and does it cover the full project?
What turbine is specified, selected or merely assumed?
What floater concept fits the site and available ports?
What mooring/anchor design is supported by the soil and coupled-load evidence?
What cable system is qualified for the voltage, motion and fatigue duty?
Which ports and vessels are actually available or contracted?
How do integration, tow-out, hook-up and energisation fit together?
Which assets are generation, OFTO or TO assets, and where are the boundaries?
What evidence shows finance maturity/FID rather than development funding alone?
How will inspection, major repair, cable failure and decommissioning be funded and delivered?
